name: (Shivver) Horned
text:
Twisted horns spiral from the shivver's skull. The horns grant the shivver a horns Strike (an unarmed attack that deals 3d10+12 piercing damage), and they gain the Powerful Charge ability.

---
Powerful Charge 2 The shivver Strides twice and makes a horn Strike. As long as the shivver moved at least 20 feet, the Strike's damage increases to 4d10+12.
